users.title: Platform Users (with role packages / data scope)

modal.assignHint: Add, remove or change roles for this user (saved as a full overwrite).
modal.deptHint: Once assigned to a department, a user holding a DEPARTMENT-scoped role will only see data of that department.

msg.deptUpdated: User department updated (data scope now applies)

roles.title: Role templates
roles.subtitle: Create and maintain platform roles (permission packages)

ph.parentId: Pick a parent role to inherit its permissions (optional)
ph.dataScopeTypes: Pick the business types this role can see
ph.dataRuleIds: Pick the departments this role can see

departments.title: Departments (hierarchy / data-scope dimension)
departments.subtitle: Maintain the department hierarchy as a tree; child departments inherit the parent's organisational scope.

ph.name: e.g. South China Region
ph.parent: Leave empty for a top-level department

permission.title: Role permission matrix (menu + CRUD + buttons)
permission.hint: Tick a box to grant that role the corresponding read / create / update / delete / export permission on the menu; data scope controls which records it can see (own / own department / all / specially authorised type).

msg.saved: Permission matrix and data scope saved

catalog.title: Permission catalogue (menu / button)
catalog.hint: Maintain the backend permission catalogue: add menus / buttons, rename, change parent, or delete. Changes are written to the backend catalogue (GET /catalog) and propagate to the menu manager and the frontend permission gate.

modal.parentPlaceholder: Select parent (leave empty for top level)

menuPermission.title: Menu permissions (RuoYi-style one-click configuration)
menuPermission.desc: Ticking a menu grants the role the matching permission; when you add a feature you only need to register its menu here and then assign it to roles, which keeps a large system easy to extend. The current catalogue comes from the backend permission catalogue (permission table).
menuPermission.empty: No permission catalogue available (backend not connected yet)

msg.loadFailed: Failed to load roles / permission catalogue: {{msg}}
msg.saved: Menu permissions saved for "{{name}}" (written to the backend)

card.structure: Navigation structure (drag to sort / regroup across centres)
card.preview: Live preview (the sidebar you will get)

alert.title: Change your menus here — no code needed
alert.descMid: is all done on this page: select a node on the left to edit its properties, use the "Move up / Move down" buttons on the right of a node or simply drag it, and use the plus buttons to add menu items and groups; when you are done click
alert.descEmph2: "Save layout" at the top right to apply it immediately
alert.descSuffix: It survives a refresh and a browser restart. If you mess things up, click "Restore defaults" to go back to the built-in menu with one click.

hint.drag: Tip: use the "Move up / Move down" buttons on the right of a node to reorder within the same group; drag a node onto another group's title to regroup it across centres (e.g. move a page from "Operations" to "System").

ph.path: A page route such as /orders; leave empty for a group
ph.icon: Leave unset to keep the default icon

empty.selectNode: Select a node on the left to edit it.

warn.unregistered: This route is not registered in App.jsx — clicking the menu will open a blank page
warn.dirty: You have unsaved changes. Click "Save layout" at the top right to apply them to the sidebar.

form.name: Name
form.pathExtra: Must be a route already registered in App.jsx, e.g. /orders; pick an existing route from the dropdown below
form.iconPlaceholder: Leave unset to use the default icon

validate.pathUsed: That path is already taken by another menu item
validate.pathUnregistered: This route is not registered in App.jsx — clicking it will open a blank page

msg.saved: Menu layout saved — the sidebar is updated
msg.groupAdded: Group "{{label}}" added — remember to click "Save layout" at the top right
msg.itemAdded: Menu item "{{label}}" added — remember to click "Save layout" at the top right
msg.keyExists: Menu key "{{key}}" already exists (the same path cannot be mounted twice)
msg.pathUsed: Path {{path}} is already taken by another menu item
msg.cannotDeletePage: This is a menu item with a page and cannot be deleted; if you do not want it visible use the "Hide" switch above
msg.hasChildren: "{{label}}" still has {{count}} menu item(s) — move them away first, deleting will remove them too
msg.builtinGroup: This is a built-in group; deleting it only lasts until the next reload, it will be added back. If you do not want it visible use the "Hide" switch above
msg.deleted: Group deleted — click "Save layout" at the top right to apply
msg.exportEmpty: The menu is empty, nothing to export
msg.exported: Menu configuration exported as a JSON file
msg.importBadJson: Import failed: the file content is not a valid menu configuration JSON
msg.importEmpty: Import failed: no usable menu node in the file (every entry needs a key)
msg.imported: Imported {{count}} top-level menu item(s) — the sidebar is updated
msg.importReadError: Import failed: could not read the file
msg.synced: Synced {{count}} menu item(s) to the backend catalogue
msg.syncPartial: Saved locally; {{count}} menu item(s) synced to the backend, {{failed}} failed
msg.syncSkipped: Saved locally; backend catalogue sync skipped ({{msg}})

hintDelete.hasChildren: This group still has {{count}} menu item(s) — move them away before deleting

settings.title: System settings

platform.title: Platform base info
platform.desc: Platform identity and default language. Configure regular menus, permissions and data scope in "Menu Manager / Role Permissions"; the section below maintains platform-level parameters.

settings.subtitle: Maintain platform-level parameters (site title, risk-control threshold switches, etc.)
